name: sigmoid-month-pairs-v1
fitting: Independent odd-month fits; next even month never enters estimation, selection or initialization. Source-cost anchors replace all inherited price-fitted bids; remove full-year empirical solar factors. Fit country/resource shared daily midpoint and spread using inverse price/quantity observations, then bounded training-only network-clearing updates. Exactly three update rounds, two declared strengths, retain best actual joint training objective; no test-driven changes.
curve: Quantity=A*sigmoid((price-source_cost-hourly_midpoint_shift)/spread); eight equal-volume midpoint-quantile offers approximate its inverse. Tranches sum exactly to source availability. Parameters shared by country/Ember family, source technology/efficiency cost anchors and zonal prices retained; no independent hourly fit.
objective: Equal mean of training equal-zone price MAE/50 and country/fuel Ember monthly absolute error/max(observed,.25TWh), plus .03 parameter ridge. Inverse initializer additionally uses available original A75 hourly generation, grouped only with all constituent technologies known. Missing zonal prices in inverse initialization use unfit own-model training prices, explicitly not observations.
scope: All 48 zones; train odd months, held-out even months only (4344 hours). Previously inspected 2025 and fixed source/structural assumptions: retrospective conditional month-ahead validation, not untouched forecasting. No annual MAE claim for the six-test composite; no baseline adoption or public explorer replacement.
physics: Existing source grid/GSK/ratings, links, fixed demand and fixed reservoir schedule retained. Raw source PV with interval correction and generic .86/.90 loss retention; no full-year generation-fitted solar factors. No capacity fitted from prices or generation. No flexible PHS/BESS in this generator-bid experiment; storage candidate is separate and unadopted.
